integrity: Self-review only; exact symbolic identities and finite test cases were checked, not externally or independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for two scalar positive curvatures 1 and 6, symmetric Markov component switching and fixed stepsize; no additive noise or arbitrary sampling chain. General Markov jump spectral tests are established prior art. An older scalar jump-system conference paper could not be fully inspected.
title: A reentrant mean-square stability window for Markov-sampled quadratic descent
